concerns.text: Task T013 'Implement code/preprocess.py: Load trajectory...' is too coarse. It bundles file I/O, streaming logic, and error handling into one atomic unit. Split into: T013a 'Create streaming loader function in code/preprocess.py', T013b 'Implement h5py chunking logic for 7GB limit'.

Task T014 'Implement code/preprocess.py: Compute non-affine displacement...' is too coarse. It requires implementing the Falk-Langer algorithm, neighbor list construction, and vector math. Split into: T014a 'Implement neighbor list builder', T014b 'Implement Falk-Langer D2_min calculation loop'.

Task T015 'Implement code/preprocess.py: Detect yielding onset...' is too coarse. It combines stress calculation, sliding window logic, and thresholding. Split into: T015a 'Implement stress-strain curve extraction', T015b 'Implement 5% drop detection over 50 steps'.

Task T021 'Implement code/analysis.py: Aggregate D2_min values...' is too coarse. It mixes k-means clustering, spatial connectivity logic, and aggregation. Split into: T021a 'Implement k-means clustering for shear band ID', T021b 'Implement mean aggregation per cluster'.

Task T022 'Implement code/analysis.py: Perform Permutation Test...' is too coarse. It requires data shuffling, statistic recalculation, and p-value derivation. Split into: T022a 'Implement permutation shuffling logic', T022b 'Implement statistic recalculation loop', T022c 'Implement p-value calculation'.

Task T029 'Implement code/predict.py: Sweep D2_min threshold...' is too coarse. It implies a loop, threshold generation, and metric calculation. Split into: T029a 'Generate threshold sweep array', T029b 'Implement FPR/FNR calculation function', T029c 'Execute sweep and collect results'.

Task T032 'Implement code/metrics.py to measure total runtime...' is too coarse. It mixes instrumentation code and comparison logic. Split into: T032a 'Implement runtime instrumentation wrapper', T032b 'Implement 6-hour limit check and reporting'.

Task T033 'Implement code/metrics.py to measure peak memory...' is too coarse. It mixes memory tracking and limit enforcement. Split into: T033a 'Implement peak memory tracking logic', T033b 'Implement 7GB limit check and reporting'.
Task T001 'Create project structure per implementation plan' is vague. Specify exact directories: 'Create directories: data/raw, data/processed, code, tests/unit, tests/integration, specs/contracts'.
Task T005 'Setup directory structure' is redundant with T001. Merge T005 into T001 or remove T005 to avoid confusion.
